partner_result_applied.result: For every probability law mu, sup_{epsilon>0,y}(mu*gamma_epsilon)(y) equals the extended L-infinity density height.
partner_result_applied.actual_application: Combined with scalar homogeneity to prove C_* = sup_{rank A>=3} s3(A) sup_y E gamma_1(Q_A-y) = sup_A s3(A)||p_{Q_A+G}||_infinity.

new_result.statement: For every bounded nonnegative probability density K, the optimal target constant C_* equals sup_{rank(A)>=3} s3(A) sup_y E K(y-X^T A X), in the extended sense.
new_result.unit_interval_equivalence: C_* = sup_A s3(A) sup_a P(X^T A X in [a,a+1]).
new_result.tent_equivalence: C_* = sup_A s3(A) sup_y E(1-|X^T A X-y|)_+, with absolutely integrable sinc-squared Fourier multiplier.
new_result.counterexample_normal_form: If C_*=infinity, a fixed-unit-window witness sequence exists with s3(A_m)->infinity.
new_result.absolute_continuity_implication: A universal unit-window bound C/s3(A) scales to P(Q_A in I)<=C|I|/s3(A) for every interval, hence yields a bounded density without continuity assumptions.
